summary.zh: 喂养与照顾把动物变成持续产出、持续占用时间的伙伴。
summary.en: Feeding and care make animals recurring producers with recurring needs.

rules.zh: 玩家为家畜准备住处、食物并定期互动，成熟后收集蛋、奶等产物。产出受成长或照料状态影响，扩大家畜数量也扩大饲料与每日工作量。
rules.en: Provide shelter, feed and routine attention, then collect eggs, milk or other products once animals mature. Growth and care influence output; a larger herd also increases feed demand and daily work.

loop.en: Process products or expand the herd

decisions.zh: 扩群前要保证饲料来源，不能只看购买动物的价格。
decisions.en: Before expanding the herd, secure feed rather than considering only the purchase price.

decisions.zh: 今天逐只互动，还是先花钱减轻喂食工作，把时间留给外出？
decisions.en: Spend today interacting with each animal, or pay to reduce feeding chores and preserve time for an outing?

effect.zh: 仅影响品质比较宽容，完全停产会迫使每日打卡。
effect.en: Quality-only effects are forgiving; total production shutdown creates mandatory daily chores.

effect.zh: 过晚容易重复疲劳，过早则削弱认识动物的过程。
effect.en: Late automation risks repetition; very early automation can weaken familiarity with individual animals.

implementation.zh: 家畜需要喂食；抚摸、心情和友好度等状态会影响动物产物，部分设施可自动化日常劳动。
implementation.en: Animals require feeding; petting, mood and friendship affect products, while facilities can automate parts of the routine.

observation.zh: 鸡舍、畜棚与围栏内家畜清晰可见，可观察照料路线与种植工作的距离。
observation.en: The coop, barn and enclosed animals are visible; inspect how care routes connect with crop work.

implementation.zh: 饲养家畜需要许可、住处、食槽与饲料；玩家照顾动物并收集蛋或奶等资源。
implementation.en: Keeping animals requires licenses, shelter, feeders and feed; players care for animals and collect resources such as eggs or milk.

observation.zh: 观察畜栏、道路和其他农场设施的邻接关系；喂食与产出的规则需看文字拆解。
observation.en: Inspect the relationship between enclosures, paths and farm facilities; feeding and production rules are explained in the text.

contrast.zh: 星露谷用友好度与心情深化个体养成；Dinkum把许可与设施准备放在入门流程里。
contrast.en: Stardew deepens individual care with friendship and mood; Dinkum foregrounds licenses and facility preparation.

combination.zh: 设计提案：每只动物偏好不同照料方式，自动设备负责基础需求，个性互动用于特殊产物。
combination.en: Design proposal: automate basic needs while individual care preferences unlock specialty products.

setup.zh: 你养了3只动物，只剩2份饲料，今天还要外出。
setup.en: You own three animals but have two portions of feed and an outing planned.

action.zh: 你先补足饲料，再决定把互动时间留给状态较差的那只。
action.en: Refill the feed, then give your limited interaction time to the animal in poorer condition.

result.zh: 动物状态得到改善，产物或生产进度显示照料效果。
result.en: Animal condition improves; products or production progress make the care visible.

next.zh: 收集产物后估算明天饲料，不急着再买新动物。
next.en: After collecting products, budget tomorrow’s feed before buying another animal.

firstStep.zh: 只做3个动物卡片、饲料库存和每日一次照料，用状态提示代替复杂行为AI。
firstStep.en: Start with three animal cards, a feed stock and daily care; use status indicators rather than complex behaviour AI.

pitfall.zh: 繁殖、疾病、自由寻路和品种差异都能扩大范围，先检查每日照料是否有取舍。
pitfall.en: Breeding, illness, roaming and breed differences expand the scope; first test the daily care choices.

test.zh: 当饲料与时间受限时，玩家是否会推迟扩群并调整照料顺序？
test.en: When time and feed are tight, do players delay expansion and change care priorities?
